roleDescriptions.owner: Full control, including deleting the organization and managing owners.
roleDescriptions.admin: Manages members, teams, projects and settings.
roleDescriptions.developer: Works on projects: runs pipelines and deploys to non-protected environments.

members.title: Members
members.removeBody: They will lose access to {{org}} and its teams immediately.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.dialogBody: They'll get an email with a link that works for 7 days.
invitations.revokeBody: The link in their email will stop working.

accept.title: Join an organization
accept.missing: This invitation link is incomplete. Open the link from your email again.
accept.signInPrompt: Sign in or create an account with the email address the invitation was sent to.
accept.wrongAccount: You're signed in as {{current}}, but the invitation was sent to {{invited}}. Sign out and sign in with that address.

teams.title: Teams
teams.description: Group members to give them access to projects together.
teams.name: Team name
teams.noCandidates: Everyone in the organization is already in this team.
teams.noMembers: This team has no members yet.
teams.deleteBody: Members stay in the organization; only the team is removed.

general.title: Organization settings
general.nameDescription: Shown to all members. The URL name ({{slug}}) doesn't change.
general.transferDescription: Make another member an Owner. You'll become an Admin.
general.transferConfirmBody: You'll become an Admin and can no longer delete the organization or manage owners.
general.noTransferCandidates: Invite someone first; ownership can only go to a member.
general.leaveDescription: You'll lose access to {{org}}. Someone will need to invite you again.
general.deleteDescription: Permanently removes {{org}}, its teams and its projects for everyone.
